destinations.name: Suzhou
destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage article "Suzhou": "a city in Jiangsu province, famed for its beautiful gardens and traditional waterside architecture"; UNESCO classical gardens; Wikivoyage covers the city and puts Kunshan, Changshu, Taicang, Zhangjiagang and Wujiang in separate articles, so the destination holds the city only.

destinations.name: Jiangnan Water Towns
destinations.coordinates_source: mean of the pins of Zhouzhuang, Tongli, Luzhi and Qiandeng (derived, not a source point)
destinations.name_evidence: Tourism brand and UNESCO Tentative List theme "Water Towns of Jiangnan"; Wikivoyage Wujiang: "a vital part of the Jiangnan water towns"; Wikivoyage Zhouzhuang: "China's oldest water town ... the Venice of China". Not a council, river or statistical region: the name visitors use for Zhouzhuang, Tongli, Luzhi and their neighbours.
